text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Today, I headed to an off-campus community center alongside Royce and Royce for an outreach event with local children.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: "Everyone~♪ Let's have lots of fun with Big Sis Royce today♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Actually, she is filling in for Tokai Teio, who had an urgent matter come up. Despite that, she is performing her role with magnificent poise.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However... that was not the only problem.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...Ticket caught a cold so I was asked to take her place, but...
Me, dealing with kids...?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'm just a stand-in too, but... Damn that Rudolf. Spouting nonsense about getting to fight a formidable opponent. This is a completely different kind of 'formidable' than what I signed up for...
choice_data_list: Wait, then... everyone today is an understudy!?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Hmm... This is quite the accident, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
That said—there's no need to worry.
You two, please take a look at this first.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: “Alright everyone! It's showtime once again!”

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
"Yay! It's the recreation big sister!"
"What are we playing today?"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Here's what we're competing with today!
Menko! Come and challenge Menko Queen Menko-chan, everyone!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Hey. What is this?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
These are records of interactions with children.
With their parents' permission, we conduct these regularly
to research what trends are popular across each generation.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: People often say kids these days are glued to their phones and video games. But surprisingly enough, they get just as hooked on old-fashioned games too.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Though its form and design have shifted,
the spirit of play lives on unbroken to this day.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Well, digging tunnels in a sandbox, for instance,
is something kids still do today, right? I used to do it too.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
And with that! The path we've walked is
still more than applicable to today's kids!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: "Now we just need to build our personas. I'll be Menko Queen, Taishin-san will be Beigoma Princess, and Brian-san will be Yo-Yo Kitty—"

text_block_list.name: Taishin & Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Like I could ever do something so embarrassing!"
"Are you kidding me?!!!!"
choice_data_list: (Of course it would turn out like that...)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, a pity. In that case,
let us switch to the simpler Plan B.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: This is something I put together on the spot just now, too. With your help, the two of you—first, we need to break the ice with the kids—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ......Well, if it's just this much—
choice_data_list: (The technique of raising the bar only to lower it...!)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Alriiiight, everyone, eyes over heeeere!
We're about to hold a ring toss tournament right here~!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
"Ehh?" "Ring toss? What's ring toss?"
"Sounds kinda boring..."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Truth be told, this here Brian-san
is the undisputed ring toss master of the academy!!
Let's all witness her transcendent skills right now!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Hey.
Since when did I become something like that?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Shh. Words like "pro" or "master" really get kids excited!
Just play along with me here...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Aaah! 1 against 3...!
As expected of a master, big sis Royce doesn't stand a chance...!

text_block_list.name: Slightly Curious Child
text_block_list.text: ...Though that expert girl missed a bunch of shots, didn't she? Maybe I'm actually better at this than her?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Oh! You there, feeling confident in your ring toss?
If you can beat Big Sister Brian,
the title of Master will be all yours~!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
"Ehh?" "A master...?"
"Maybe I should give it a try?"

text_block_list.name: Excited Children
text_block_list.text:
"Go!" "Ah, so close!"
"A little more to the right~!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Hey.
The cookies are done baking, for now.

text_block_list.name: Excited Children
text_block_list.text:
"Ooh, looks yummy!"
"Ah, Carrot Man cookies!"
"Did you make these, big sis?"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Fufufu... A special snack for a special event. Plus the older girl who can make it! Looks like everyone's totally hooked...!

text_block_list.name: Event Organizer
text_block_list.text:
I-Incredible... Is she really just a student?
She looks like a total pro...!
choice_data_list: She really comes alive when it comes to producing...

text_block_list.name: Event Organizer
text_block_list.text:
I-Incredible... Is she really just a student?
She looks like a total pro...!
choice_data_list: She really comes alive when it comes to producing...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, please give me a shout if another opportunity comes up!
Next time, make it an official offer, okay?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Alright! Then it's just about my turn! Let me show you what a recreation big sister can really do!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even against a bunch of kids, Royce and Royce's
producing prowess shone brightly throughout the day.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Now then, next let's play tag
with big sis and the others!
Who do you all wanna challenge~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, despite the sudden accident,
Royce and Royce wonderfully
managed to liven up the event!
